facts.text: For fall 2025, UVA admitted 4,092 of 17,370 Virginia applicants and 5,086 of 39,271 out-of-state applicants; 2,531 of the 3,978 enrolled first-years were Virginians.
Binding Early Decision admitted 1,376 of 4,969 applicants for fall 2025, a much higher rate than the overall 10,086 of 64,457.
State residency is rated 'very important' in UVA's admission decisions (CDS C7), alongside rigor, class rank, GPA and character.
The waiting list is long but rarely used: 5,225 students accepted a place for fall 2025 and 125 were admitted.
First-year tuition for 2026-27 is 19,309 for Virginians and 59,035 for non-residents, before required fees of 3,945.

In CDS C7, UVA rates rigor of secondary school record, class rank, academic GPA, character/personal qualities and state residency 'very important'; application essay, recommendations, extracurricular activities and talent 'important'; standardized test scores, first generation, geographical residence, volunteer and work experience 'considered'; interview, alumni relation, religious affiliation and level of interest 'not considered'.

notes: All CDS figures read on 2026-10-13 from UVA's interactive CDS (Qlik extensions embedded in https://ira.virginia.edu/common-data-set/common-data-set-2025-2026). C1: 29,657 + 34,776 + 24 = 64,457 applied; 4,564 + 5,520 + 2 = 10,086 admitted; 1,779 + 2,198 + 1 = 3,978 enrolled (all full-time). C12 GPA and C11 distribution are blank. C14 closing date 01/05, C16 notification by 4/01. ira.virginia.edu, sfs.virginia.edu and admission.virginia.edu return HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch, so the SFS 2026-27 cost of attendance page (sfs.virginia.edu/financial-aid-new-applicants/financial-aid-basics/estimated-undergraduate-cost-attendance-2026-2027) and the admission office testing page could not be opened: cost totals are null and the test policy comes from CDS C8A. UVA's SFS page mentions MyinTuition for schools that meet 100% of demonstrated need, but no official aid-promise text (AccessUVA, income thresholds) could be opened, so aidPromise is null. No official fall 2026 class numbers recorded.
